notes: Stability: the plugin now stays out of the DDO SDK during the moment each quest/zone loads and unloads — the fragile window where the game was most likely crashing — by pausing its background timers for a few seconds around every transition. Adds a 'Restart plugin' button in the sidebar that rebuilds this plugin's own overlay and timers without touching DungeonHelper (use it if the popup ever freezes), and health logging so any remaining crash can finally be diagnosed. Also quiets the state-file write spam.
